parameters.jsCode: const p=$json; const v=[]; if(p.runId!=='SUB-OPS-006'||p.gate!=='G4')v.push('identity'); if(p.workflowId!=='WF-SUB-OPS-006-G4-001'||p.workflowVersion!=='1.0.0')v.push('workflow'); const c=p.control||{}; if(!c.manualOnly||c.scheduleEnabled||c.webhookEnabled)v.push('trigger'); if(c.maxExternalActions!==0||c.maxNotionWrites!==0||c.spendingAuthorityCents!==0||c.maxAiCalls!==0||c.retryOnUnknownOutcome)v.push('authority'); if((p.requestedActions||[]).length)v.push('requested actions'); const raw=JSON.stringify(p); if(/(?:password|api key|access token)\s*[:=]\s*\S+/i.test(raw)||/(?:\d[ -]*?){13,19}/.test(raw))v.push('sensitive data'); return [{json:{...p,guardStatus:v.length?'Rejected':'Accepted',violations:v}}];

const p=$json; if(p.guardStatus!=='Accepted')return [{json:{runId:p.runId,gate:p.gate,status:'Review',guardStatus:p.guardStatus,violations:p.violations,records:[],exceptions:[],externalActionsPerformed:0,notionWritesPerformed:0,spendingCents:0,aiCalls:0}}]; const groups=new Map(); for(const x of p.items){const email=String(x.accountEmail||'').trim().toLowerCase(); const key=[String(x.vendor).trim().toLowerCase(),email||'unknown-email',String(x.productPlan).trim().toLowerCase()].join('|'); if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,[]); groups.get(key).push(x);} const records=[]; const exceptions=[]; let dup=0; for(const [key,list] of groups){list.sort((a,b)=>a.observedAt.localeCompare(b.observedAt)); const x=list[list.length-1]; dup+=Math.max(0,list.length-1); const monthly=x.billingCycle==='Annual'?Math.round(x.amountCents/12):(['Monthly','Usage-based'].includes(x.billingCycle)?x.amountCents:null); const confidence=x.trustLevel==='verified'&&x.accountEmail&&x.renewalDate?'High':(x.accountEmail||Number.isInteger(x.amountCents)?'Medium':'Low'); if(list.length>1)exceptions.push({severity:'Info',category:'DUPLICATE_EVIDENCE',dedupeKey:key}); if(x.trustLevel!=='verified')exceptions.push({severity:'Medium',category:'UNVERIFIED_EVIDENCE',dedupeKey:key}); if(['Low','Unused'].includes(x.usageState))exceptions.push({severity:'Medium',category:'LOW_USAGE',dedupeKey:key}); records.push({dedupeKey:key,vendor:x.vendor,productPlan:x.productPlan,accountEmail:x.accountEmail,status:x.trustLevel==='verified'&&x.claimedStatus==='Active'?'Verified Active':'Candidate',billingCycle:x.billingCycle,amountCents:x.amountCents,currency:x.currency,monthlyEquivalentCents:monthly,renewalDate:x.renewalDate,cancellationDeadline:x.cancellationDeadline,confidence,sourceEvidence:list.map(e=>({evidenceId:e.evidenceId,sourceType:e.sourceType,sourceRef:e.sourceRef,observedAt:e.observedAt}))});} return [{json:{runId:p.runId,gate:p.gate,workflowId:p.workflowId,traceId:p.traceId,status:'Pass',guardStatus:p.guardStatus,records,exceptions,duplicatesSuppressed:dup,summary:{proposedSubscriptionCount:records.length,monthlyEquivalentCents:records.reduce((s,r)=>s+(r.monthlyEquivalentCents||0),0),exceptionCount:exceptions.length},externalActionsPerformed:0,notionWritesPerformed:0,spendingCents:0,aiCalls:0}}];
